description: A harness that fixes programs: a model is given the program that failed and what it failed with, and tools to look and to try a fix, until it has one or says there is none. Named as a run's repairWith; it is given what a runner hands a fixer.

returns.unfixable?: string: why there is no fix, where the model says there is none
returns.asked: number: how many requests were made of the model

input.prompt: A harness that fixes programs: asked for a fix where a run names this project as repairWith.
